summary.text: Phoebe Tucker is the Democratic candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Rutland-Windsor District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
In a Ballotpedia survey, her campaign described her as a lifelong Ludlow resident and third-generation Vermonter.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Phoebe Tucker's responses list her campaign's key messages as improving daily quality of life for working-class Vermonters through access to affordable healthcare, food and housing, and improving the public education system while limiting the resulting tax burden on those who cannot afford it.
They also state support for the partial repeal of Act 181 and a pause to develop a community-led, incentive-based model.
She named human rights and services, social justice, climate change and environmental resiliency, healthcare, education and economics as policy areas of interest.
